question: In the pulverized-coal boiler, what ammonia flow rate is used in the cofiring case whose coal feeding rate is 20.33 kg/s?
rendered:
Based on the information in the document "Carbon-Free Ammonia Co-firing in Fluidized Bed Combustion: Analysis of Advanced Chemical Modeling and Detailed Mechanism" is not relevant to this question, so I will use the other document.

According to Table 9 in the document "Ammonia Co-Firing in a Staged-Air Pulverized-Coal Boiler: Reactor-Network Prediction of Carbon Reduction and Nitrogen-Oxide Emissions":

Item Pure coal combustion Case 1 Case 2 Case 3 Case 4 Ammonia blending ratio (%) 0 20 40 60 80 Coal feeding rate (kg·s^− 1) 50.83 40.67 30.5 20.33 10.17

The coal feeding rate for the case with 20% ammonia blending ratio is 40.67 kg/s. 

According to the same table, the ammonia flow rate for the case with 20% ammonia blending ratio is 10.29 m^3/s.

So, the ammonia flow rate used in the cofiring case whose coal feeding rate is 20.33 kg/s is 10.29 m^3/s.
